messages:
Olivia (Support): handing off urgent support -> CS. Several trial accounts can't complete activation because activation emails are delayed or never arrive. Admins see pending status even though our mail service shows 250 accepted.
Jamal (CSM): which accounts affected and any renewal impact?
Olivia (Support): affected: MediWave (pilot, 90 seats, renewal 2026-11), BrightCare (trial, 15 seats, trial ends in 7 days), AtlasRx (pilot, 22 seats). MediWave is high-touch, risk flagged for renewal outreach if unresolved.
Priyanka (SE): logs show our email worker is throttling outbound due to sudden bounce rates from a new mail relay change. Worker returns 202 but client side shows "delivered=false". snippet: ```WARN email/worker: outbound throttle triggered, relay=relay-2, drop_count=320```
Riley (CS Ops): tagging status-bot to create incident and track.
status-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-840 created, severity=P1, owner=@priyanka_se. Playbook: email-relay-throttle.
Jamal (CSM): CS comms proposal: 1) Notify MediWave + BrightCare within 30m, 2) Offer manual activation and dedicated onboarding session, 3) For MediWave offer credit + a technical walkthrough. Who will own the actual customer messaging?
Olivia (Support): I can run manual activation steps if Priyanka provides API or console flow. Will wait for token.
Priyanka (SE): short-term workaround: use admin console -> Teams -> Actions -> Force Activate OR API: `POST /internal/v1/team/force_activate {team_id}`. Support can use a scoped token I just created (TEMP-ACT-456), expires 3h. Curl: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer TEMP-ACT-456" https://api.redwood.ai/internal/v1/team/force_activate -d '{"team_id":"<team_id>"}'``` don't paste token publicly.
Olivia (Support): running force_activate for BrightCare now.
Jamal (CSM): draft message for MediWave: "We're aware of delayed activation emails affecting some teams. Engineers are investigating and we've enabled a manual activation. We can schedule a dedicated onboarding session and discuss credits for disruption. ETA initial mitigation within 2 hours. — Jamal, CSM" I'll send after confirmation the workaround works.
Riley (CS Ops): timeline and owners: Priyanka - triage + rollback of relay change, Olivia - execute manual activations, Jamal - customer outreach + renewal playbook for MediWave, Riley - status page + exec summary. Check-ins every 30m.
Priyanka (SE): rolling back the relay routing change to relay-1 canary now. Monitoring outbound accept rate and bounce metrics.
status-bot: Canary started for relay routing rollback. Watch email bounce rate for 20m.
Olivia (Support): BrightCare manual activate succeeded, invite emails accepted by admin. Running for AtlasRx now.
Priyanka (SE): canary stable for 25m, bounce rate dropped from 18% -> 0.6%. promoting full rollback.
Olivia (Support): AtlasRx activated. MediWave manual activation queued; starting now.
Jamal (CSM): called MediWave and they accepted manual activation plus offered onboarding slot. I'll log them as "at-risk" and prepare renewal outreach plan with suggested 5% one-time credit.
Riley (CS Ops): status page updated: "Investigating delayed activation emails; manual activation available; engineers applied rollback to mail relay. Updates every 30m." Posted.
Priyanka (SE): created incident timeline and will own postmortem (INC-2026-840). Initial root cause: relay routing change + conservative retry logic causing effective throttling. Long-term fix: adaptive retry + relay health checks.
status-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-840 status -> resolved, resolved_by=@priyanka_se, resolution_summary="rollback relay routing + manual activations".
Jamal (CSM): thanks team. I'll follow up with MediWave on renewal outreach and add notes to the account health dashboard.
Olivia (Support): collecting logs and timestamps for the postmortem. Closing after postmortem link posted.
Riley (CS Ops): comms record saved: https://redwood.internal/cs/records/INC-2026-840. Will close thread 2h after postmortem link is available.
